abstract: Background/Objectives: Within-cycle changes in circulating tumor-derived DNA may provide prognostic information in pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC). This exploratory study investigated KRAS-mutated cell-free DNA (mKRAS cfDNA) dynamics during the first chemotherapy cycle and their associations with disease characteristics, progression, and overall survival. Methods: A total of 40 patients contributed 151 plasma samples collected at Pre-cycle, Early-cycle, Post-infusion, and Late-cycle time points. Droplet digital PCR targeting KRAS codons 12, 13, and 61 quantified mKRAS cfDNA concentration and mutant allele fraction (MAF). Total cfDNA and CA 19-9 were also evaluated. For the analysis of survival associations, patients were followed for up to 4 years. Results: mKRAS cfDNA was detected in at least one sample from 29 patients (72.5%). Pre-cycle mKRAS cfDNA concentration and MAF were higher in patients with metastatic disease (all p < 0.0001). Both parameters decreased between Pre-cycle and Late-cycle (both p < 0.001), whereas total cfDNA showed no significant overall change. mKRAS cfDNA and MAF weakly correlated with CA 19-9 at most investigated time-points (ρ 0.396-0.523). Late-cycle positivity was associated with shorter subsequent overall survival after adjustment for age and metastatic status (adjusted hazard ratio 5.36; 95% confidence interval: 1.54-18.64; p = 0.0083). Clinical sensitivity analyses yielded directionally consistent estimates; however, the association was attenuated and became statistically inconclusive after adjustment for CA 19-9 dynamics. Pre-cycle positivity and early increases in MAF were associated with shorter survival in unadjusted analyses but did not retain significance after adjustment. No significant associations with progression were identified among 31 evaluable patients. Conclusions:Late-cycle mKRAS cfDNA detection warrants further evaluation as an on-treatment prognostic marker in PDAC. Larger studies with standardized sampling and external validation are needed to establish its clinical usefulness and added value beyond established assessments.
key_points_ko: 총 40명의 환자 중 29명(72.5%)의 적어도 한 샘플에서 mKRAS cfDNA가 검출되었습니다.
치료 주기 전(Pre-cycle) mKRAS cfDNA 농도와 변이 대립유전자 분율(MAF)은 전이성 환자에서 더 높았습니다.
치료 후기 양성 검출은 보정된 위험비 5.36으로 더 짧은 전체 생존기간과 연관되었습니다.
진행(progression)과의 유의한 연관성은 31명의 평가 가능한 환자 중에서 확인되지 않았습니다.
summary_ko: 이 연구는 췌관선암(PDAC) 환자 40명을 대상으로 첫 항암 치료 주기 동안 KRAS 변이 세포유리 DNA(mKRAS cfDNA)의 변화를 조사했습니다. 연구 결과, 치료 후기(Late-cycle)에 mKRAS cfDNA가 검출된 경우 연령과 전이 여부를 보정한 후 더 짧은 전체 생존기간(OS)과 연관성을 보였습니다. 그러나 CA 19-9의 변화를 함께 보정했을 때는 통계적 유의성이 유지되지 않았습니다. 초록에 명시되지 않은 내용 외에 더 큰 규모의 표준화된 후속 연구가 필요합니다.
title: Plasma KRAS-Mutated Cell-Free DNA Dynamics and Prognostic Associations During the First Chemotherapy Cycle in Pancreatic Ductal Adenocarcinoma
title_ko: 췌관선암 환자의 첫 항암 치료 주기 동안 혈장 KRAS 변이 세포유리 DNA 역동성과 예후 연관성
